_provenance.sourceTitle: APPENDIX VI – NDCC Ballroom Syllabus Step List, Competitions & Medal Test
_provenance.sourceAuthor: George Pytlik / National Dance Council of Canada
_provenance.column: Quickstep (column 4 of 4: Waltz · Tango · Foxtrot · Quickstep)
_provenance.method: Two-pass BLIND verification (stronger than Foxtrot's single-pass 220-DPI crop). Pass 1: independent `pdftotext -layout` column extraction. Pass 2: independent transcription from a 220-DPI rasterized crop of the Quickstep column (numbers + names columns isolated). The two passes were produced in separate contexts with no cross-reference, then reconciled by `diff`; disagreements were resolved against the source raster. Names are exactly as printed; nothing expanded, corrected, or inferred.
_provenance.status: EXTRACTED — pending Victor's confirmation. Not yet audited.
_provenance.rules: Figure-name → tier/number is dance content. This file is the verbatim NDCC side only. Matching these names to ballroomguide figure names is a separate step done by Claude Code in the parser, with fuzzy/unmatched pairs flagged for Victor (never guessed). ballroomguide coverage gaps are NOT recorded here — they belong in the Step 4 anomalies doc.
notes: syllabusNumber is per-dance and cumulative across tiers — Quickstep runs its own 1..31 sequence, NOT a global number shared with the other dances.
Beginners tier IS populated for Quickstep (figures 1–5), unlike Foxtrot whose Beginners cell is blank. Per-tier counts: Beginners 5 / Pre-Bronze 8 / Bronze 7 / Silver 6 / Gold 5 = 31.

Viennese Waltz band EXCLUSION (decision, not omission): the Quickstep column crop was vertically trimmed at approximately y 0.762 of page height to drop the 'Valse Viennoise / VIENNOISE' band that bleeds into the bottom of column 4. The trailing 'Gold Star-Etoile d'Or / Steps 1–7 / Figures 1–7' block below that line is Viennese Waltz content and is deliberately not transcribed here.
Column geometry (page-width fractions, for reproducibility): Quickstep numbers 0.7553–0.7815; Quickstep names 0.7815–0.9758.
V6 (#25) is stored with NO space, per Victor's ruling ('V6' is the figure name). The source raster shows 'V 6' with typographic spacing; that space is not part of the name.
Gold Star tier lists no individual figures: the source states 'Steps 1– 31 plus Gold Star groups / Fig. 1 – 31 plus groupes Etoile d'Or'. No Gold Star figure records are emitted (same as Foxtrot).

Tier labels are bilingual in the source (e.g. 'Pre-Bronze – Pré-Bronze', 'Silver - Argent', 'Gold - Or'); syllabusLevel uses the English form (normalized to 'Pre-Bronze') to match existing data.js Waltz/Tango entries.

APOSTROPHE: no Quickstep FIGURE name contains an apostrophe. The only apostrophe in the column is in the 'Etoile d'Or' tier label, which is never emitted as a figure record and never becomes a data.js key — so the curly-vs-straight apostrophe question is cosmetic and does not affect matching.
